welcome.title: Welcome to SpeakCore
welcome.body: In a few steps you'll set up your SpeakCore instance and create the owner account. No voice servers are installed yet.

mode.title: Choose system mode
mode.body: You can change this mode later.
mode.simpleDesc: Guided and focused on the essentials – recommended to get started.
mode.expertDesc: More detail and overrides for experienced administrators.

account.title: Create owner account
account.body: This account has full control over SpeakCore.
account.passwordHint: At least {min} characters, with upper- and lowercase letters and a digit.

errors.ownerExists: An account already exists. Setup cannot be run again.
errors.locked: Setup is locked (SETUP_LOCK). No owner can be created.
errors.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.passwordWeak: The password does not meet the requirements.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.

login.title: Sign in
login.body: Sign in with your owner account.
login.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Please try again later.

new.title: Connect existing TS3 server
new.hint: Credentials are stored encrypted and never shown in plain text.
new.name: Display name
new.queryPortHint: ServerQuery port (default 10011), not the voice port.
new.voicePortHint: Client voice port (default 9987). Optional, informational only.

status.title: Status
status.unreachableHint: The server could not be reached. Check host, port and credentials.
status.name: Server name
status.readonlyNote: Read-only. Start/stop, management and installation will follow later.

errors.hostBlocked: This host is not allowed for security reasons.
errors.virtualServerInvalid: The virtual server ID is invalid.
errors.credentialsRequired: Please enter a username and password.
errors.encryptionMissing: SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set – credentials cannot be stored securely.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
errors.connectionFailed: Connection failed. Please check your details.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.placeholderHint: Voice server management will follow in a later step.

systemcheck.title: System Check
systemcheck.subtitle: Preflight & Capacity Advisor
systemcheck.intro: This assessment estimates what your system can handle.
systemcheck.demoNotice: Example data – no real system measurement is performed yet.
systemcheck.disclaimer: Conservative recommendation, not a guarantee. Real measurements will follow via the SpeakCore Agent in a later step.

network.title: Network
network.noExternalTest: No external reachability tests are performed. Public reachability (ports/NAT) will be checked separately later.

details.ipv6only: IPv6 only – some clients/networks may not reach the server
details.proxmoxVm: Proxmox VM – recommended for production installs
details.lxcExpert: Proxmox LXC – Docker recommended in Expert Mode only
details.bareMetal: Bare metal – good for large/dedicated setups
details.vps: VPS/root server – mind network, firewall and backups
details.nasHome: NAS/home server – for small communities, often limited

upgrades.useVm: Use a VM instead of LXC for production installs
